correctness.rationale: The exact local repair identity D_c equals the hub mismatch plus a sum of independent binary-edge orientation repairs. Summing three repair costs gives the unrestricted upper bound; nonnegative monochromatic source groups attain it at all orders. An exact profile (1,m,m) pins the ordinary repair hub and explicit parity-sensitive source words attain the matching upper bound. The weak m=2 and m=3 cases are completely separated by singleton location and number of monochromatic blades. Three cyclic copies achieve an admissible global profile and sum of unrestricted repair distances. The standalone verifier reproduces all three radii exhaustively for m=1..6 (1793610 all words; 15590 legal disturbances) and checks explicit extremizers for m=2..100. Infinite truth is from proof, not computations.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-order classification of three related correction radii on friendship graphs, not a generic numerical exercise. The sharp weak-profile obstruction m=2,3 and explicit linear-in-m difference Fix_3 minus B_w for m>=4 expose a concrete mechanism for previously studied weak-villainy nonadditivity; three copies realize a provably unbounded exact superadditivity gain 3 floor((m-1)/3). The general repetition theorem is credited, and the exact family evaluation contributes motivated new input.
